H2.10 (reinvest low-res savings into a longer 32 px tail with fractional, step-indexed switches) is the obvious way to land just above the bar, and it has never been run. critiques.target: SGD-era refutations carried into the Muon regime
critiques.issue: Width (E005, E017), activation (E003 SiLU -0.6 pp) and the LR floor (E015) were all tested only under SGD at full resolution. E022 showed that SGD lessons on step count did not transfer to Muon. With Muon's flatter epoch slope (0.54 vs 0.95 pp/epoch), the exchange rate for narrowing group 1 or 2 changes too. A cut that cost 0.115 pp per 1% under SGD might cost much less now. The H6 text lists the Muon LR floor (0.05) and a short final EMA as untested, but no idea has been queued for them.
critiques.suggestion: Re-test one capacity lever on the Muon tip: group-2 width 384->352 at bs 1536. Pre-register the exchange rate it must beat (bs 1536: 0.064 pp per 1%). Also queue the LR floor and EMA under Muon as one H6 probe.

critiques.issue: E036 bundled two changes. The +9.8% time is attributed to cudnn.benchmark=False as 'almost certainly', with no measurement. The cheap follow-up (Muon compile mode change alone, cuDNN benchmark left on) was identified and never run. Restoring determinism would halve the noise on paired comparisons, and that noise is the main bottleneck now that margins are ~0.1 pp.
critiques.suggestion: Run the unbundled probe: Muon update in mode='default' with cudnn.benchmark=True, plus an untimed seed-0 repeat. Even if it costs ~1% time, it can be used only for comparison runs while scored runs keep max-autotune.

critiques.issue: Cross-seed sd is ~0.22 pp (seeds 3-10), yet E006 (0.02 pp range), E034 (0.05) and E035 (0.04) had almost identical seeds. Each is individually plausible, but H2.1.3, the cheap check that augmentation and data-order RNG actually depend on the trial seed after the progressive-resize rewrite, is still open. If seeds share augmentation streams, the 3-seed mean understates variance and the official 40-seed extrapolation is miscalibrated.
critiques.suggestion: Run H2.1.3's hash log once (untimed) on the current tip: first-batch augmentation hash and data-order hash for seeds 0-2 plus a seed-0 repeat.

critiques.issue: The latest gain, bs 1536 (E038), comes mainly from per-step and launch overhead, which does not shrink with GPU power. On the official 300 W PCIe card, GPU work runs slower, so fixed per-step overhead is a smaller share. The time saving likely shrinks while the -0.30 pp accuracy cost stays. The cost table (16 px 0.32x, 24 px 0.57x) may also shift. Neither the 16 px nor the bs-1536 levers have been checked for sensitivity to this.
critiques.suggestion: Record in H2.4 that levers whose gain is per-step (bs, CUDA graphs) are at higher risk of not transferring to PCIe than FLOP-reducing levers. When two candidates tie locally, prefer the FLOP-reducing one.

structured_output.summary: The current tip, E038 (bs 1536: 0.7542 / 5.216 s), clears the local 0.753 bar by only 0.11 pp. The two runs average exactly 0.7542, and the margin check on seeds 3-10 was never repeated for this recipe. The run-to-run noise model in H4, which every keep/discard decision now depends on, rests on about two rerun pairs. Several conclusions read noise as signal: E035's accuracy gain (later conceded), 'diminishing returns' for 16 px epochs (it vanishes once E026's lucky run is averaged out), and E041's 20 px refutation, which was judged against E035's lucky 0.7572. The most informative surprise is E038 saving ~2 ms per removed step, twice the predicted Muon cost. This contradicts the power-cap model for the 16/24 px phases. It reopens overhead levers (CUDA graphs, per-phase batch size) that were closed only for full-res SGD, and it predicts that bs 1536 transfers poorly to the 300 W PCIe judge. Directions never tried: different total epoch counts under Muon or a fractional 32 px top-up (H2.10), per-phase batch size, width/LR-floor/EMA retests under Muon, and the unbundled determinism probe. Bookkeeping lags the evidence. H7.1.1/H7.1.2/H7.2.1/H6.3.1 statuses contradict their own bars, H5's evidence signs are inverted, and H7's 0.75 confidence ignores four null accuracy probes.
